lines.speaker: Rusk
lines.text: I know which one is tired. Watch the feet.

lines.speaker: Rusk
lines.text: That is not the same as knowing which one will lose.

description: A spectator who watches feet to recognize a tired fighter, then distinguishes that observation from knowing who will lose. His knowledge is particular and fallible. He offers no guaranteed betting advice or special combat power.
name: Rusk
